text: Lactulose is not in milk: it is made from lactose, often from whey lactose, by warming a lactose solution with an alkaline catalyst until part of it rearranges. The syrup is then purified; a crystalline product is made by crystallising it.

links.name: US 6214124, lactulose syrup by lactose isomerisation (sodium aluminate)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: rearrange
steps.note: The lactose solution is warmed with an alkali (sodium hydroxide, sodium carbonate, ammonium carbonate, sodium aluminate or borate) for minutes to a few hours, so the glucose half of lactose becomes fructose.

steps.name: crystallise
steps.note: The syrup is crystallised, to make the crystalline product.
